items.source: The Spring AI project defines a configuration property named spring.ai.stabilityai.api-key that you should set to the value of the API Key obtained from Stability AI.
items.translation: Spring AI 项目定义了一个名为 spring.ai.stabilityai.api-key 的配置属性，您应当将其设置为从 Stability AI 获取的 API Key 值。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.stabilityai.image is the property prefix that lets you configure the ImageModel implementation for Stability AI.
items.translation: 前缀 spring.ai.stabilityai.image 是用于配置 Stability AI 的 ImageModel 实现的属性前缀。

items.source: On start-up, the default options can be configured with the StabilityAiImageModel(StabilityAiApi stabilityAiApi, StabilityAiImageOptions options) constructor. Alternatively, use the spring.ai.stabilityai.image.* properties described previously.
items.translation: 在启动时，可以通过 StabilityAiImageModel(StabilityAiApi stabilityAiApi, StabilityAiImageOptions options) 构造函数来配置默认选项。或者，也可以使用之前描述过的 spring.ai.stabilityai.image.* 属性。

items.source: Spring AI supports Stability AI’s text to image generation model.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持 Stability AI 的 文本生成图像模型。

items.source: You will need to create an API key with Stability AI to access their AI models. Follow their Getting Started documentation to obtain your API key.
items.translation: 您需要创建 Stability AI 的 API 密钥才能访问其 AI 模型。请按照其入门文档获取您的 API 密钥。

items.source: You can set this configuration property in your application.properties file:
items.translation: 您可以在您的 application.properties 文件中设置此配置属性：

items.source: There has been a significant change in the Spring AI auto-configuration, starter modules' artifact names. Please refer to the upgrade notes for more information.
items.translation: Spring AI 的自动配置中，starter 模块的 artifact 名称发生了重大变化。 请参阅 升级说明 获取更多信息。

items.source: Spring AI provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for the Stability AI Image Generation Client. To enable it add the following dependency to your project’s Maven pom.xml file:
items.translation: Spring AI 为 Stability AI Image Generation Client 提供 Spring Boot 自动配置。 若要启用它，请将以下依赖添加到您项目的 Maven pom.xml 文件中：

items.source: or to your Gradle build.gradle build file.
items.translation: 或者添加到您的 Gradle build.gradle 构建文件中。

items.source: The prefix spring.ai.stabilityai is used as the property prefix that lets you connect to Stability AI.
items.translation: 前缀 spring.ai.stabilityai 被用作属性前缀，让您能够连接到 Stability AI。

items.source: Enabling and disabling of the image auto-configurations are now configured via top level properties with the prefix spring.ai.model.image.
items.translation: 启用和禁用图像自动配置现在通过带有前缀 spring.ai.model.image 的顶级属性进行配置。

items.source: The StabilityAiImageOptions.java provides model configurations, such as the model to use, the style, the size, etc.
items.translation: StabilityAiImageOptions.java 提供了模型配置，例如要使用的模型、风格、尺寸等。

items.translation: 为了在处理 API 密钥等敏感信息时增强安全性，您可以使用 Spring Expression Language (SpEL) 来引用自定义的环境变量：

items.source: You can also set this configuration programmatically in your application code:
items.translation: 您也可以在应用程序代码中通过编程方式设置此配置：

items.source: The URL to connect to
items.translation: 连接的 URL

items.source: The API Key
items.translation: API 密钥

items.source: To enable, spring.ai.model.image=stabilityai (It is enabled by default)
items.translation: 若要启用，请设置 spring.ai.model.image=stabilityai（默认已启用）

items.source: To disable, spring.ai.model.image=none (or any value which doesn’t match stabilityai)
items.translation: 若要禁用，请设置 spring.ai.model.image=none（或任何不匹配 stabilityai 的值）

items.source: This change is done to allow configuration of multiple models.
items.translation: 此更改是为了支持配置多个模型。

items.source: spring.ai.stabilityai.image.enabled (Removed and no longer valid)
items.translation: spring.ai.stabilityai.image.enabled (已移除且不再有效)

items.source: Optional overrides the spring.ai.openai.base-url to provide a specific url
items.translation: 可选参数可覆盖 spring.ai.openai.base-url 以提供特定的 URL

items.source: Optional overrides the spring.ai.openai.api-key to provide a specific api-key
items.translation: Optional 覆盖了 spring.ai.openai.api-key 以提供特定的 api-key

items.source: The number of images to be generated. Must be between 1 and 10.
items.translation: 要生成的图像数量。必须在 1 到 10 之间。

items.source: The engine/model to use in Stability AI. The model is passed in the URL as a path parameter.
items.translation: 在 Stability AI 中使用的引擎/模型。该模型作为路径参数传递在 URL 中。

items.source: Width of the image to generate, in pixels, in an increment divisible by 64. Engine-specific dimension validation applies.
items.translation: 要生成的图像宽度（以像素为单位），需为 64 的倍数。将适用特定引擎的维度验证。

items.source: Height of the image to generate, in pixels, in an increment divisible by 64. Engine-specific dimension validation applies.
items.translation: 要生成的图像高度（以像素为单位），且必须是 64 的倍数。将适用特定引擎的维度验证。

items.source: The format in which the generated images are returned. Must be "application/json" or "image/png".
items.translation: 生成的图像返回格式。必须为 "application/json" 或 "image/png"。

items.source: The strictness level of the diffusion process adherence to the prompt text. Range: 0 to 35.
items.translation: 扩散过程对提示文本遵循的严格程度。范围：0 到 35。

items.source: Which sampler to use for the diffusion process. If this value is omitted, an appropriate sampler will be automatically selected.
items.translation: 用于扩散过程的采样器。如果省略此值，系统将自动选择合适的采样器。

items.source: Random noise seed (omit this option or use 0 for a random seed). Valid range: 0 to 4294967295.
items.translation: 随机噪声种子（省略此选项或使用 0 以获取随机种子）。有效范围：0 到 4294967295。

items.source: Number of diffusion steps to run. Valid range: 10 to 50.
items.translation: 要运行的扩散步数。有效范围：10 到 50。
